question: Which types of wood are assigned to the eastern and other directions for fuel sticks?
premises: Udumbara, banyan, aśvattha, and plakṣa woods are named.
These are used as fuel sticks.
They are assigned to the east and other directions.
inference: Udumbara, banyan, aśvattha, and plakṣa fuel sticks are assigned in the east and other directions.
uncertainties: The exact one-to-one mapping of each wood to each direction is not fully specified in this verse.
plain_english: Udumbara, banyan, aśvattha, and plakṣa are used in the east and the other directions.
